notes.title: Range Day VR Update 13 70% off sale.
notes.content:
Yes, we know we suck but we did finally get around to releasing that long overdue large game update.  And as a way to thank all of you who have been waiting a 70% sale discount will be happening March 4th -18th as our way to say thank you to all of those who have waited on us for this update to purchase our game.  Your support is greatly appreciated. 

So what’s news you ask?  

-Support for index, vive, and oculus latest controllers
-New hand animation system.
-New guns.
-New Ranges
-Updated graphic engine
-Updated physics engine.
-LOTS AND LOTS of bug fixes. To many to list.

notes.title: Update 10 development.
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Its been a while since we reached out.  Its been a crazy year and our small team is currently working on several projects.  Good news is we are back to working on Range Day VR and update 10. We are currently working on adding full index controller support (“Knuckles”) to the game with a new hand animation system as well as new ranges and new guns along with a bunch of bug fixes. We thought we would share some screen shots of the new ranges in development  as well as a few of the new guns in the next update. Thank you to all of our players as you are the reason we enjoy  building games.

notes.title: Update 9 has launched and been updated!
notes.content:
Post update 9 patch U2

-       Updated Ammo tray system.  Ammo trays can be picked up easier. 
        Turn ammo trays upside down to dump all ammo on table.You can 
        touch the top of a magazine on the ammo tray to load bullets 
        automatically.  You can pick up individual bullets from the ammo tray by 
        hand only if the ammo tray is being currently held.  
-	Updated more gun recoil systems 
-	Updated sounds for several guns
-	Updated floor destroy system for guns and other items, Simply thow a 
        gun or item on the floor and it will disappear after 30 seconds unless its 
        been picked up pior.
-	Fixed remote pickup ability on several guns.
-	Revolvers can be emptied by opening the drum 
        and tilting the gun backwards to dump out casings. 

Post update 9 patch U1

-      Fixed player height issue.
-      Adjusted holster belt tracking location.


Changes and bug fixes. 

-	Complete gun recoil system rebuild 
-	Complete physics on all gun models 
-	Updated Attachment System and shot alignment system.  
-	Added smudge and wear marks on several gun models. 
-	Fixed several gun mechanics bugs. 
-	Target Selection & Armory menus span in specified locations.
-       Fixed gun held positions in hands broken in previous patch. 
-       Adjusted recoil rates on firearms broken in previous patch.   

New   

-	Updated Gun holster system now featuring a tactical vest. 
-	Added MSBS556 machine gun 
-	Added Kriss Vector machine gun 
-	Added Stoner 63a machine gun 
-	Added H&K 416 machine gun. 
-      Added working Lantern on Forest night and Savannah House myst 
       ranges.

notes.title: Patch 07 has launched.
notes.content:
Patch 07 has launched for all platforms. We hope you enjoy the reactive ranges as they are in beta status and will be updated with feedback we get from all of you!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hello everyone. Just wanted to give an update to patch 07. Its taking longer then we were  hoping b ut hope to get the patch out to you mid-November or sooner. Attached are several screenshots of some of the new outdoor ranges.  We will try an upload video footage of the reactive ranges in action in the next week or so.  Patch 07 is extremely large and we all appreciate your patience as we work through development issues. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28062992/6d75eb28e8334d97752b533a17c53c094cb9072a.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28062992/f5954f09472f03dd383df6f9a9fb5c408aafa0c6.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28062992/e359e64b98680d6395024e39b0dcde3d0d4e2cfe.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28062992/ddc7fb6bba9ccd05b6e5b579313ac13e9caf37bc.jpg[/img]



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hello everyone.  Patch 07 is going to be a very large patch as we plan to introduce several new rifles, Kimber SOC, Barrett, and CZ Bren 2 just to name a few.  Patch 07 will also introduce new outdoor ranges and the advanced reactive range type.  Advanced reactive ranges have randomly spawned Silhouette targets that shoot back at the player. You will need to take cover if you are going to survive!  We will also be doing more refinement for rifles and adjustments to scope and sight attachment accuracy.  Patch 07 we hope to get to you all by the end of October and will post more details and pictures of content as we build out this patch. As always thank you all for your continued support and patronage!

notes.title: Patch 05 Released. Please READ
notes.content:
Patch (5) Version 1.16.88

Changes 

- Updated Armory menu system.

- Adjustments and particle updates to muzzle flash system. More still to come. 

- Increased speed of slide and bolt animations on guns when firing. 

- Ammo trays added to armory.  These are experimental and subject to change. To pick up an ammo tray press and hold down either the grip ore trigger button prior to moving your hand next to the tray base it should snap to your hand.  If you turn the trays upside down all the bullets will fall loose. With the trays already laying on the table you can pick up bullets individually from the tray or place the magazine next to the ammo tray to suck in bullets. 

- Long chargeback handle pull fixed on galil and scar rifles.

- Beta holster belt.  You can turn this on in the options menu from the armory menu. Comes with 4 magazine, 2 hand guns, and one rifle holder on your back.  It may be necessary to take a step back once you load a new range to be in the center of the holster belt. It should then teleport with you whenever you relocate.  Expect more variations and refinement to this in future patches.
 
- New bolt rifle system update. You will now need to manually pull the bolt up and then back to eject a cartridge and slide it forward to advance the next round from the magazine.

notes.title: Patch Version 1.16.01 P04 is live.
notes.content:
Version 1.16.01 P04


Changes:

- Auto score target system: Indoor ranges now have two types of targets. A vast library of paper targets as well as select group of paper targets that auto score the players shooting skills against a time clock.  More auto targets will be added in future updates.

- Gun changes:  Slide release only works if an empty magazine is removed or no magazine is present. Bolt on rifle auto locks back on last round fired.

- Target reset button slow.  Fixed time out issue when player tried to reset bullet marks on targets. Works quickly now.

- Fixed memory leak issue with NVidia card drivers.

More fixes in a patch over the weekend that didn’t make this one in time.

notes.title: Patch P03 1.15.22 released.
notes.content:
Game notes 1.15.22 P03

Changes:

-	Updated weapon spawn system. Now all guns in the inside ranges attempt to drop gun, mag, ammo, and attachments on different areas of the table to avoid a pile.  Outside ranges still drop everything on one spot of the table since several weapons are already on the table by default.
-	Options Menu added.  Located in the Armory menu. Ability to turn off magazine status text, and enable or disable beta content. More to come.
-	Beta guns added.  Turn on by the options menu. One handgun and one machine gun have been added using a different muzzle flash system. We want feed back from everyone on this if possible. Please test in the indoor ranges and outdoor ranges, porch and forest especially.
-	Updated haptic feedback system on the HTC Vive. Guns should feel more enjoyable when you shoot.
-	Lots of gun fixes, 
-	Delta Elite gun and 10mm ammo added.

notes.title: Patch updates this week: UPDATED Please read!
notes.content:
We had originally planned to try to get a patch out by Thursday and another end of the weekend. Some of the features we want to get into these patches are taking a little longer than planned and others cannot be split between two patches as they depend upon each other to function.  So its looking like one big patch end of the weekend.  The last thing we want to do is release something early and create a new problem when the goal is to fix and refine.  The focus of the patch will be the same as stated earlier but with a few extra things thrown in.  We think its important to keep you all informed when plans change. Don’t hesitate to msg me if you have any questions. 
_____________________________________________________

After talking with the team today we are shooting for a new patch release Wednesday or Thursday.  Also more than likely another one on Sunday. Obviously there will be more bug fixes with the guns but there are some areas we want to focus on.  The items here may fall in one or the other patch depending upon when they are done.

- Improved haptic feedback for the vive.
- Options control panel: where you can turn off and on features of the game and enable beta features in testing.
- Another spawn system upgrade: dropping gun, mag, ammo, and attachments on different areas of the table to avoid fall clutter.
- Muzzle flash system:  We want to introduce a few test guns using a new muzzle flash system that you can enable by the options menu.  We want feedback on these to get a feel for what everyone likes or hates as there seems to be more than one group of thought to what muzzle flash should look like.
- explosive reactive targets for the outdoor range.
- Introduction of the Delta Elite and 10mm round into the game.
- lots more bug fixes on guns and quality of play items

notes.title: Mega Patch P02 is live
notes.content:
Hello everyone.  We have worked hard this weekend and fixed quite a few issues in the game.  We have concentrated on the worst issues and are working our way down the list.  There will probably be a patch update every 3 days or so till they are all knocked out.  Any new issues please post in the bug discussion as It really has been helpful.   This patch contains updates to the recoil system.  I am sure we are not done tweaking it and more than likely it will receive further updates in near patches.  Thank you all for your help and for playing Range Day VR. 

Version 1.14.02 P02

Change log:


- Improved weapon recoil system. This may receive another enhanced upgrade later.
- Weapon spawn upgrade: Weapons now spawn directly to tables near you. This is true for outdoor ranges as well so please go back to the table to pick up your weapon.  Weapons can still fall of the table if your table is to full.  Throw weapons on the floor to destroy.
- New teleport system.  A Yellow circle has been added to show where you will land. A blue teleport line shows the spot you have selected is good and a red teleport line shows an area is bad. The blue circle will turn green on items you can pick up by teleport. 
- Weapon destroy time has been increased from 10 seconds to 20 seconds once items are thrown on the floor.
- Oculus players: slide / bolt release button is now thumb stick up on either controller.
- Fire-select button: Besides using the physical button on the guns players can now use a mapped fire-select button on their controllers.  Oculus: Left controller: thumb stick right, Right controller thumb stick left. Vive: touchpad button right.
- Slow menu response fixed.
- Numerous gun fixes with attachments and alignment.

notes.title: Range Day VR Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone. We will be launching Range Day VR for early access soon and wanted to share with you what is to come in the near future.  We will be updating features, expected content, as well as post a newer and more up to date tutorial video as quite a bit has changed in the past few months from what was originally posted.  

Launch features. 

6 Indoor Ranges:
5 Outdoor ranges, various target types, including simple reactive targets.
Tons of realistic guns.

We have 2 large updates for the game already in development and hope to launch in the next few months after early access release.  The order of these two updates may change depending upon which completes first out of development.

Update 1:

Advanced reactive target ranges.
We have two new outdoor ranges that will test your shooting skills as the targets not only move but also will shoot back. You will not last long staying in one position!

Wild West Saloon: Dodge incoming fire as bandits and outlaws spring up from windows, behind tables, bars and various other challenging locations. 

Wrong Turn Alley: Sometimes you make a wrong turn into the bad part of the big city.  Test your shooting skills as you take out reactive targets of street thugs taking shots at you from the apartment windows above or alley corners in front of you.

Update 2:

Multiplayer support.  This is an important update for us. We are launching native versions of Range Day VR for both oculus and vive platforms.  It’s also more fun if we can all play together regardless of which platform you own.  Competitive fun and co-op gameplay between a host of existing ranges and new multiplayer exclusive ones are in development with voip support.  Initially we may launch one or two multiplayer ranges to test content and work out bugs before we add additional ones.  

Other content:

Other single player content ranges include a junk yard and heavy weapons and explosives range in development.  We will be adding additional guns often and sometimes independent of new range updates.  We also want to reward our early access players who may endure buggy software and many updates as we refine the play experience and add new features based on player feedback.  A few of the nicest guns in the game will be exclusive to early access players and not be available to players who purchase the game after full release.

Who should by this game now?

Anyone who likes to play things early, offer advice and feedback as we fine tune, add features, and work out game bugs we find along the way should buy.  

Who should not buy this game at this time?

Anyone who only wants to play a game once all the features have been released.  We completely understand those players and look forward to having you as part of the Range Day VR family a little later down the road once all updates are out.  Please feel free to ask any question in the discussion areas of the community hub and we will respond as soon as possible!

notes.title: An update for everyone.
notes.content: Hello everyone.  A quick update which may not make a few of you happy. We are pushing out the release date to the end of July.  One of our VR partners which we shall not name released a new runtime update just recently that is causing tracking issues with the controllers.  Our QA people have also identified a memory leak issue that needs to be addressed as well as a few other optimizations.  Just some of the many joys of game development! We know many of you are patiently awaiting the release but we feel it’s important to release a good experience to begin with regardless of our anticipated early access launch.  We plan on releasing sneak peaks of some additional content in the next week or so as well.

notes.title: Brief game release delay and additional content.
notes.content:
Game delayed! Not the words that any gamer wants to hear but after careful consideration after meeting with the entire dev team we have decided to briefly delay release of the game.

Why did you delay the release?

        Several reasons.  Range Day VR was originally designed for the Oculus Rift before we decided to build a completely native steamvr version.  After review with internal QA we have decided the SteamVR controls need a little more love and polish before release.  Planned additional content that was originally going to be pushed out in an update is close to release so we want to go ahead and include that in the main game at launch.  Additional changes to range levels will be implemented in preparation for multiplayer support that will be added in a future update.

How long of a delay?

        We are targeting a release date of June 30th but may release the game sooner if everything completes faster.  The last thing we want to do is change the release date again so we have allowed extra time for additional development, game polish, and additional QA checks before release in case its needed. If we decide the game is ready and will launch ahead of its revised release day we will post it publicly in advance to keep everyone informed. 

The game is early access so why the delay?

        Even though the game will be launching for early access we still feel the game needs to provide a great experience even if it’s not perfect.  There are a lot of bad VR games out there and it’s important not to rush a product out the door before its truly ready to have players engage with it.  We know a lot of players may be disappointed by the delay but we think in the end the results will be worth it. 

Additional Content.

        We have added a very cheesy short video demonstrating basic firearm interaction in the game.  We have received a lot of email asking in depth how guns worked in Range Day VR and hope this helps address a few of those questions. Please note this game will be launching in early access and we fully expect to implement changes and refinements to how the weapon interaction system works. We will also be posting additional content and information about the game in the next few weeks so stay tuned!

https://youtu.be/i7WCWbJiXwQ

notes.title: Hello Everyone!
notes.content:
We will be posting lots of updated information over the next week and half regarding the gameplay for Range Day VR including an updated trailer showing newer game play updates as well as tutorial videos showing how to use basic weapons within the game.  We did want to take a few minutes and answer a few of the questions we have been receiving a lot of through email.
 
1.	Is the game simply point and shoot or does the game allow you interactivity with your guns?
     Range Day VR supports in depth interactivity with the firearms you use.  Even down to manually picking up a bullet off the table and loading it into your magazine. Game mechanics are designed to feel natural including all actions of using the firearm. 

2.	Does Range Day VR support both Oculus Rift and SteamVR natively?
     Range Day was originally designed for the oculus and oculus touch system but we are making a native port for both platforms
. 
3.	When will multiplayer support be supported?
     Range Day VR will initially launch with single player only. Multiplayer support is heavily in development for both the Oculus Rift and SteamVR platforms.  We hope to launch multiplayer support with the first few updates to the game along with new weapons and ranges that are also in development.  This is one of the reasons why we are launching the game in early access as player feedback will be help us greatly refine multiplayer features. 

4.	Does Range Day VR support PIMAX VR?
No.

5.	Will Range Day VR be coming to GEAR VR?
No.
